summary_md:
# Svevik gör börsdebut – strategens svenska AI-vinnare

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon, 23 Sept 2026, with guests Esbjörn Lundvall (equity strategist, SEB) and Robin Berglund (adviser, Redeye). Both see the market as strong, lifted by earnings growth, and they judge the new AI disruption scare (Meta's Muse hitting insurers) as probably overdone. Esbjörn argues that Nordic AI winners such as Munters, Wärtsilä, Hexatronic and Mycronic are priced too low for their earnings growth, and names Mycronic as the stock most likely to beat expectations. The episode also covers Svevik's lukewarm First North debut, serial acquirers stabilising (SEB pushes Röko as undervalued), and a warning that the Swedish market looks expensive, with a risk premium back near 2007 levels.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MYCR — Mycronic | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Guest Esbjörn (SEB) picks it as the stock most likely to surprise consensus positively, driven by AI-exposed Global Technologies and new product launches.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (SEB strategist). The fastest-growing divisions, PCB test and die bonding, are directly exposed to data centres. New products and a move into inspection, launched at the CMD, should lift orders late in the year. Fears of a cyclical downturn in pattern generators may be partly offset. The valuation is off its peaks but not strikingly low.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the pattern generator division enters a deep cyclical downturn
- if order intake does not pick up by year-end
- if AI data-centre capex slows

> *"Ska jag välja någon som jag faktiskt tror kan överraska i förhållande till konsensusprognoserna på den positiva sidan så skulle det vara Mycronic."*

---

### 🟢 ROKO-B — Röko | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

SEB is pushing Röko today as undervalued relative to larger serial-acquirer peers despite high quality. The stock rose 2.7% on the call.

#### Reasoning

Guest/cited analyst opinion: SEB's own published call, presented by strategist Esbjörn. SEB says the company's high quality is not reflected in its relative multiple. Acquisitions are highly profitable, with an average EBITA margin of 22%, which should reduce leverage over time. Robin (Redeye) notes goodwill and a stretched balance sheet as the main objection.

#### Sell Triggers

- if leverage rises further
- if acquired-company profitability falls
- if goodwill write-downs occur

> *"Vi pushar till exempel Röko idag som ett, tycker vi, alldeles för bra bolag i förhållande till sin värdering, relativt större peers."*

---

### 🟢 HTRO — Hexatronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Profits turned in Q2 after 11 weak quarters, with further acceleration expected. Data-centre exposure is rising and P/E is about 15. Both guests find it attractive.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion from both Esbjörn (SEB) and Robin (Redeye). Esbjörn calls it a real winner on the strongest secular trend with undemanding multiples. Its data-centre division and US fibre are gaining AI-related drivers. Robin agrees the valuation still looks interesting after a 70-80% crash from its pandemic peak. The share has historically been highly volatile.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the earnings recovery stalls in H2
- if the data-centre demand slowdown hits orders
- if US fibre demand weakens again

> *"Också ett jättebra exempel på ett bolag som är en riktig vinnare på den starkaste makrotrenden vi har"*

---

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Down about 30%, with P/E near lows despite high expected profit growth. Esbjörn calls it an obvious AI winner but the margin gains may be delayed.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (SEB). Order intake shows Munters is a big winner from the data-centre investment wave in cooling and water. Esbjörn expects several more years of the boom. Risks: US margin improvements may slip a few quarters, the business is project-based with limited aftermarket revenue, and the multiple may be less attractive than it looks. Esbjörn says: 'I like the case anyway.'

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin improvement from US investments is delayed further
- if data-centre order intake slows
- if AI capex overbuild materialises

> *"jag tycker att de är en så uppenbar vinnare på den här enorma investeringsvågen"*

---

### 🟢 WRT1V — Wärtsilä | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Phenomenal profit growth and a transformation driven by power generation for AI data centres. The market overreacted to its guidance that orders will flatten.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (SEB). Power supply for new data centres is a key bottleneck, so Wärtsilä is well placed. Q2 orders were so strong that management flagged a plateau, and the market soured. Esbjörn calls that reaction silly.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake falls materially
- if data-centre power demand weakens

> *"Det här är definitivt ett bolag som sitter i en fantastisk sits när just elförsörjningen till nya datacenter är en av de riktigt stora flaskhalsarna."*

---

### 🟠 NCAB — NCAB | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Extreme organic growth from AI data-centre PCBs. Robin says the quality larger acquirers are where to look now, though you pay for it.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Redeye). NCAB benefits from demand for advanced PCBs in AI data centres and from its broad supplier network amid bottlenecks. The share is up about 30%. It has a cleaned-up balance sheet and cash for acquisitions, so growth can continue, but the valuation is already rich.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI-related PCB demand slows
- if the supply bottleneck advantage fades

> *"NCAB har ju extrem organisk tillväxt."*

---

### 🟠 SDIP-B — Sdiptech | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

High organic growth and up about 30%. A cleaned-up balance sheet and good cash allow acquired growth too.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Redeye). Robin groups it with NCAB as a quality acquirer with both organic and acquired growth potential. It has already re-rated, so you pay for the quality.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth slows
- if valuation expands further without earnings support

> *"Det finns nog ändå rimlighet att de kan fortsätta öka."*

---

### 🟢 SWEC-B — Sweco | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Handelsbanken upgraded it to buy from hold, and the stock rose 6%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion (Handelsbanken), not host or guest. It was only reported as a market move, with no further discussion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the upgrade momentum fades
- if Q3 report disappoints

> *"Sweco stiger 6 %. Där har Handelsbanken höjt rekommendationen till köp från tidigare behåll."*

---

### ⛔ FG — Fasadgruppen | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Leverage is about 4x EBITDA, double that of peers, and it is a much smaller company. Robin prefers the larger quality names.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Redeye), implied rather than explicit. It is contrasted with quality acquirers because its balance sheet is weaker and leverage higher. Robin says the larger quality companies are where to look now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if leverage is reduced meaningfully
- if organic growth recovers

> *"Fasadgrupperna å andra sidan ... har ju haft en lite tuffare skuldsättning, upp fyra gånger ebitda nu"*
